scope_statement: This ledger covers the historical core and Connection/Linear-A artifacts identified and actually inspected during the current dialogue audit. It does not falsely claim that every JSON in the repository has already been read; additional files are appended in subsequent batches.
historical_policy: Do not mutate or delete legacy originals. Add v2 interpretation overlays and execution receipts.

global_findings.name: LEGACY_NUMERIC_PSEUDOPRECISION
global_findings.finding: Many older records use 0-1 strength/confidence values without an externally validated calibration set.
global_findings.upgrade: Treat legacy values as historical detector rankings only; v2 requires calibration status and evidence receipts.

global_findings.name: EPISTEMIC_LAYER_COLLAPSE
global_findings.finding: Early registry versions often co-locate source claims, observations, interpretations, and semantic hypotheses.
global_findings.upgrade: Use typed evidence states and claim ceilings; a source assertion is not a JANUS observation and an interpretation is not a causal result.

global_findings.name: INDEPENDENCE_DENOMINATOR
global_findings.finding: Files, revisions, hashes, receipts and summaries can multiply repository nodes without multiplying independent generating events.
global_findings.upgrade: Count at the deepest defensible unit: field/claim/event/witness/failure-domain/external-source.

global_findings.name: SELF_GENERATED_CONTEXT
global_findings.finding: Connection scans become searchable context for later scans and can induce recursive confirmation.
global_findings.upgrade: Primary discovery run must exclude prior Connection outputs; use them only as hypothesis memory after scoring.

global_findings.name: RELATION_NOT_RECURRENCE
global_findings.finding: A recurring abstract operator is weak evidence unless a targeted intervention can selectively destroy the relation while matched statistics remain.
global_findings.upgrade: Use survival vectors, preserved-property reports, relation rewiring, matched nulls and held-out partitions.

global_findings.name: TEMPORAL_CONFOUNDER_SPLIT
global_findings.finding: Temporal rewiring can unintentionally destroy freshness and thereby imitate predecessor-specific dependence.
global_findings.upgrade: Separate relation rewire, freshness-only manipulation and alternative-predecessor controls.

global_findings.name: EXTERNAL_CORPUS_ADVANTAGE
global_findings.finding: Linear A is a stronger validation environment because its corpus was not authored to fit JANUS vocabulary.
global_findings.upgrade: Use it for blind partition/null/held-out testing, but do not infer decipherment from structural transportability alone.

global_findings.name: BAYES_IS_ONLY_AS_EMPIRICAL_AS_ITS_LIKELIHOODS
global_findings.finding: Legacy Bayesian/Monte-Carlo layers can be mathematically correct yet epistemically over-strong when priors/likelihoods are expert supplied.
global_findings.upgrade: Label outputs assumption-conditional until likelihoods are externally estimated/calibrated and held-out predictions succeed.
